findings.rationale: GA's uploaded updates are anti-aligned with the federation median in essentially every round (mean cos about -0.74, z=-11.3) and are about 2.5x the median norm (z=+5.8 on size-adjusted norm). The per-round values show this from round 1 onward (cos -0.58, norm ratio 3.18 in round 1; cos -1.0 in several rounds). This is a scaled, sign-flipped update pattern. Its local performance looks normal (AUC 0.78, CITL -0.008), so the anomaly is in the uploads rather than in the local data.

MN's updates are strongly anti-aligned with the median (mean cos -0.89, z=-12.4) and about 5.3x the median norm (size-adjusted z=+7.1). The pattern holds in every round from round 1 (norm ratio 4.73, cos -0.88). Local AUC (0.80) and CITL (0.02) are normal, so the local data look fine and the manipulation is in the uploaded update.

NY's updates point against the median in almost all rounds (mean cos -0.94, z=-12.9) and are about 5.3x the median norm (size-adjusted z=+7.0). The pattern is present from round 1 (norm ratio 5.13, cos -0.72) and continues through round 20. Local performance is normal (AUC 0.83, CITL 0.017), which is consistent with a manipulated upload rather than bad local labels or drift.

report.summary: Screened all 52 clients with the update, performance, drift, feature, and subgroup (Sex, AgeGroup, Income) tools, then confirmed suspects with narrower queries. Three clients (GA, MN, NY) show a consistent poisoning signature: their updates point against the federation median (mean cos -0.74 to -0.94, z between -11 and -13) and are 2.5x to 5.3x the median norm, from round 1 onward. Their local AUC and CITL look normal, so the problem is in the uploads, not the data. Other flags were treated as noise: GU and VI drift flags were not stable at the epsilon I could afford; CT's GenHlth outlier did not persist on confirmation (p99 4.98, normal); the small-group subgroup outliers (CT, WY, PR in AgeGroup 5; TX, NH in Income) had only moderate noise-adjusted z (about 3-4) and no under-diagnosis pattern (O/E was high, not low). No label_noise, prevalence_shift, missing_artefact, free_rider, or explanation_instability evidence was found. Budget spent: about 19.7 of 20.
